S0.headline: Substrate: pi ~ ln 2 under prequential (P4 0.6933, P16 0.6957); net beats logistic; delay 64 best (0.327 vs 0.377 at 0 and 0.442 at 512)
S0.verdict: PARTLY. Seed 5 has no close pi offsets and gives pi P4 0.6942 / P16 0.6948 (near ln 2), so the pi claim holds only for seeds without a pi-offset pair within W=32 (62.9% of seeds 1-2000 have one; seed 4 gives 0.521). The delay ordering does not reproduce: on both fresh seeds (3 and 5) delay 0 is best (0.365/0.361) and delay 64 is worse than delay 0 (0.384/0.393), so 'delay 64 is best' is refuted.

L1.headline: Novelty review: 45 sources verified, 15 claim rows, flags F1-F23 drop no arm
L1.verdict: YES. All quoted numbers are in the cited PDFs; one label is wrong (EoM numbers are in the introduction, not the abstract).

T1.headline: Theory: Euler identity, exact = tangent + KL, telescoping all exact to 1e-13; books do not track true income (R2 0.32 SGD / 0.14 Adam)
T1.verdict: YES for the identities (deterministic reruns). Three small numeric claims are refuted on two fresh seeds (hindsight gap 0.046 -> 0.044/0.042; self-resolved income 0.056 -> 0.054/0.055: sd understated, direction holds); the periodic plateau ratio 0.29 swings 0.003-0.80 across seeds.

M1.headline: Gradient credit carries no usefulness signal; LOO settlement does; CURRENCY.lock = committed-trader settlement only
M1.verdict: YES for the toy and the census (0.256 +- 0.059 vs 0.026 +- 0.022). The lock's why(b) wording is refuted (top neurons are negative less often than the base rate under most books); the decision stands.

M2.headline: Gate B coalition win: NO (books tie |Taylor| and movement on random coalitions)
M2.verdict: YES for the NO. On a fresh held-out segment the tie holds (book-Taylor -0.11/+0.06/+0.01); the absolute coalition Spearman drops (0.818 -> 0.74 +- 0.14) and the single-neuron 'win' becomes a tie.

M3.headline: Stop rule fires: no book currency beats gradient norm; fixed share 1e-3 beats Kelly on lock-in
M3.verdict: YES as scoped to book currencies (fresh segment). Read literally, exact LOO settlement beats gradnorm by 0.245 +- 0.097 (3/3), so the plan's wording 'nothing beats |a.g|' is false; fixed share reproduces (gain 0.70/0.73/0.75).

M5.headline: The prequential net is exploitable: probe L phi 0.092 (P4) / 0.118 (P16) nats per q-step; price-only probe ~2% of that
M5.verdict: PARTLY. The net is exploitable on every fresh seed (probe L phi P4 0.071/0.034, P16 0.092/0.122 at seeds 4/5; price-only probe P4 0.0022/0.0019, P16 0.0024/0.0017), so the qualitative claim holds. The magnitudes do not: P16 phi 0.118 +- 0.0007 lands at z -38 (seed 4, pi leak) and z +6.4 (seed 5, no leak); 5-seed P16 phi 0.114 +- 0.012 (sd 18x the quoted one).

M6.headline: Gate B base_arms_survive = true (10 survive, 5 dropped); cg/cq/fb01 pools trade ~0.001 nats of noise protection
M6.verdict: YES for the gate (verdict files re-read; stress pass later drops cg and fb01). Fresh seeds 4/5: the cg noise level reproduces (0.0020/0.0021 vs 0.0022 +- 0.0002) and cg < BOOST holds on both; (a)'s noise excess 0.0108 +- 0.0006 is refuted as quoted (0.0121/0.0122), ES's edge over (a) shrinks to -0.0008 at seed 5 (sign holds); the 2-pass fixed point 'not kept' stays unverified (mixed).

M7.headline: dsfw beats DeepSeek on bce_all (E8 -1.30%, E64 -1.87%) but pays post-shift; wealth_beats_deepseek = false
M7.verdict: YES. Seed 4 (CPU) reproduces the edge (E8 -1.38%, E64 -3.70%) and the post-shift cost (+0.056/+0.077); the false flag is a judgement (best of 3 variants, family labels, post-shift cost), not a failed replication.

M8.headline: Income gating hurts vs no gate; |a.g| gate + rebirth does not beat random reinit 3/3 -> stop
M8.verdict: PARTLY. The stop decision stands on seed 5 (absag - random post-shift +0.0010, absag not better), but seed 4 gives absag -0.083 because it learnt LFSR16; the whole-run ungated BCE lands on opposite sides (0.340/0.372 vs 0.355 +- 0.007). |a.g| > income Spearman holds on both fresh seeds (0.166 > 0.032, 0.129 > 0.083).

M9.headline: Soup = lottery (Brier 0.25 - D(1-(1-pi)^{K/Q}), R2 0.79-0.94); K/Q shows no trend in the net
M9.verdict: PARTLY. The lottery fit and the no-trend claim reproduce (byte-identical reruns; seed 4 inside the band). The very-thin-trader cost is refuted as quoted (+0.0068 +- 0.0002 vs fresh +0.0081/+0.0076) but its sign (K=64 worse) holds on 5/5 seeds.

K1.headline: Niches keep the economy alive; money conserved (4.1e-12); after a shift births recover in 833 steps (newborns 0.98)
K1.verdict: PARTLY. Conservation and the no-monoculture stop rule hold. The shift numbers are refuted as quoted: newborn share 0.87/0.88 on seeds 4/5 vs 0.979 +- 0.004, recovery 1700/500 steps vs 833 +- 58 (5-seed 940 +- 451). Births still dominate after the shift.

V1.headline: Grafana view of wealth-net; step-23300 table (head -1241 +- 69, comp 4147 +- 267)
V1.verdict: PARTLY. The dashboard and the summary JSON check out; 10 of 14 quantities reproduce on 2 fresh GPU seeds; head wealth sd is understated 5.6x (pooled -1039 +- 388) and comp 3.2x; the 23300 table is a mid-run cut (runs now at step ~31.1k).

G1.headline: GPU queue: ledger = GCE receipts x $0.87/h, total $6.07, <= 2 VMs, zero VMs left
G1.verdict: YES for the money (23/23 VMs, diff $0.000000; total $6.0673). The cron runner jams while any job runs (job-run.sh inherits flock fd 7), so 'dispatches every 2 min' is refuted.
